logic.entry: On a newly closed UTC daily bar j, signed efficiency=(close[j]-close[j-L])/sum(abs(close[k]-close[k-1]), k=j-L+1..j); flat denominator yields0. If flat, enter only when signed efficiency > entry_hurdle_fraction; strict inequality.
logic.exit: When long, exit when signed efficiency<=0; otherwise preserve prior target. Entry and exit depend only on L+1 completed daily closes.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.citation: TA-Lib KAMA source: net movement / accumulated absolute one-bar movement efficiency construction.
sources.scope: Motivation and denominator definition only. This signed flat=0 trading filter is an explicit adaptation, not KAMA smoothing or a profitability replication.
Official execution filter definitions; current filters are historical proxies.
